description: A React hook that traps focus within a specified container element when active, primarily for accessibility purposes.

methods.name: useFocusTrap(containerRef, isActive)
methods.description: A React hook that traps keyboard focus within a specified container element when active.

parameters.name: containerRef
parameters.description: React reference to the container element within which focus should be trapped.

parameters.name: isActive
parameters.description: Flag indicating whether the focus trap should be active.
